dial.summary: TOTAL crypto market cap remains under pressure following the October 30 Binance-scare crash that wiped $1.49B in liquidations (86.8% longs); DXY holds above 100 at 101.67 and real yields at 2.63% sustain headwinds despite a notable 30bps decline over the past four weeks; Global M2 continues to expand (~$104.3T) and the Fed balance sheet is stable at $6.75T, but the crypto-specific structural breakdown and macro tightening overhang keep the dial at Risk Off.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: G4 M2 aggregate (Fed/ECB/BOJ/PBOC) at ~$104,317B (~$104.3T) for September 2026 (MacroMicro Sep 2026; up from August $103.66T = +$0.65T, +0.6% MoM); US M2 at $23.41T in September 2026 (H.6 updated Oct 27, 2026; +5.7% YoY); no confirmed October 2026 G4 aggregate at time of run (next full release expected mid-November); 4-week trend UP (August $103.7T → September $104.3T confirmed; US M2 weekly tracker near $23.5T in October); status supportive (4-week trend is up).

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: October 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI not yet released — due November 2, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET; latest confirmed reading is September 2026 at 54.5% (released Oct 1; August was 54.6%, 4-week change −0.1pp within flat threshold); ninth consecutive month above 50; S&P Global flash US Manufacturing PMI for October came in at 56.0 (up from 55.9 in September — a separate index); Prices Paid at 77.9% multi-year high in September; status neutral (above 50 but not rising on 4-week ISM basis).

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY spot closed ~101.67 on October 30, 2026 (Dealplexus; day range $101.57–$101.91); October 31 is Saturday with no new market data; Trading Economics reported 102.00 for Oct 30 (possible index discrepancy); 4-week trend UP (end-Sep ~100.5 → Oct 30 ~101.67, +1.2%); status headwind (above 100 threshold); BOJ held at 1.25% Oct 30 with hawkish December signal; Q3 GDP 3.4% and Sep PCE 3.6% YoY (Oct 29) reinforce USD bid and December hiking expectations.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10) closed at 2.63% on October 29, 2026 (portfolio-terminal.com; FRED DFII10 Oct 28 = 2.67%); 4-week trend DOWN — yield fell from ~2.93% at end of September to 2.63% on Oct 29, a decline of ~30bps, the steepest monthly improvement since June 2026; status supportive per rules (falling trend triggers supportive regardless of absolute level); absolute level remains elevated and restrictive in conventional terms; October 31 is Saturday, next FRED update expected Nov 3.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: October 30, 2026: 10Y=4.927%, 2Y=4.586%, spread=+34bps (247wallst.com; Oct 29 spread ~+37bps per prior data); 4-week trend DOWN (Oct 1 ~+42bps → Oct 30 ~+34bps, −8bps flattening); the 2Y fell more than the 10Y on Oct 30 as traders priced a December cut/hold pivot; curve remains positive (not inverted), well above −50bps headwind threshold; status neutral (positive but flattening, below prior +37bps reading).

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL Oct 28, 2026 = $6,745,635M ($6.75T) per FRED (H.4.1 released Oct 29); Oct 21 = $6,753,604M; Oct 14 = $6,755,639M; week-over-week Oct 28 declined ~$8B from Oct 21 but remains within a narrow band; 4-week trend FLAT (Sep 30 ~$6.743T → Oct 28 ~$6.746T = +$3B, +0.04%); next H.4.1 release scheduled November 5, 2026; status supportive (flat, post-QT-pause stabilization plateau).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: OI-weighted BTC perp funding rate ~0.0087% per 8h averaged across 6 exchanges (DeFiRate, ~Oct 23 snapshot); Convextrade shows 0.01% as of Oct 20, 2026; 30-day trend DOWN (early Oct ~0.0137% per 8h at the highs cited by CoinDesk Oct 2 → ~0.0087% late Oct); October 30 crash ($1.49B liquidations, 86.8% longs) likely pushed funding toward zero or slightly negative post-flush; well below the 0.04% headwind threshold; status supportive (low leverage, post-liquidation environment).

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$297.3B (DefiLlama Oct 30, 2026; USDT 60.64% dominance within stablecoins); total crypto market cap estimated ~$2.55T (BTC ~$77K × ~19.75M supply / BTC.D ~59.5%); implied dominance ~11.7%; 30-day trend UP (Sep 30 ~10.5% → Oct 30 ~11.7%); rising dominance primarily reflects contracting total crypto market cap (Oct 30 crash, $1.49B liquidations) rather than new stablecoin inflows; status neutral — headwind condition requires rising TOTAL, which is declining; TOTAL also rising condition not met.

upcoming.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM releases October 2026 Manufacturing PMI at 10:00 AM ET — first Q4 manufacturing read and key December FOMC input; September ISM was 54.5% (ninth consecutive month of expansion) with Prices Paid at 77.9% multi-year high; S&P Global flash October Manufacturing PMI came in at 56.0, suggesting resilience; a print above 55 strengthens December hiking odds, below 52 would signal deceleration; prior Polymarket consensus clustered in the 52.0–52.9 range.

upcoming.title: JOLTS Job Openings (September 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases September 2026 Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS) at 10:00 AM ET — pairs with the September NFP of +29K (weakest of the cycle) to give a fuller labor market picture; a sharp drop in job openings below 7M would reinforce evidence of labor softening and complicate December 8–9 FOMC hiking narrative; quits rate will also be watched for worker confidence signals.

upcoming.title: ADP Employment Report (October 2026)
upcoming.note: ADP releases October 2026 National Employment Report at 8:15 AM ET — private-sector payroll preview ahead of BLS NFP on November 6; September NFP was +29K (weakest of the cycle, well below +90K consensus); an ADP beat above 100K would raise October NFP expectations and reinforce December hiking odds; a second consecutive weak print would amplify recession concerns and likely cap DXY and real yields.

upcoming.title: ISM Services PMI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM releases October 2026 Services PMI at 10:00 AM ET — released same day as ADP; services sector accounts for ~70% of US GDP, so a miss below 50 would be an outsized macro signal; a combined strong Services PMI and ADP beat would solidify December 8–9 hiking expectations and sustain DXY and real yield headwinds for risk assets.

upcoming.title: Bank of England Rate Decision (November 2026)
upcoming.note: Bank of England MPC announces Bank Rate at 12:00 PM UK time with Monetary Policy Report — current Bank Rate at 3.75% (held September 17, 6-3 vote); markets pricing ~69% probability of no change; a surprise hike would strengthen GBP, add to global tightening pressure, and ease DXY headwinds for risk assets; BOJ held at 1.25% on October 30 with hawkish December signal, adding context for G10 CB divergence.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended November 1, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET for the week ended November 1 — released same day as BOE decision, one day before October NFP; final labor-market read before Friday's NFP print; a spike above 230K would temper December 8–9 FOMC hike expectations and could amplify risk-off pressure following the October 30 Binance-scare selloff.

upcoming.title: US Employment Situation — NFP (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases October 2026 nonfarm payrolls at 8:30 AM ET — the critical December 8–9 FOMC input; September NFP was +29K (weakest of the cycle); a rebound toward 100K+ would stabilize the labor narrative and support December hiking expectations; a second consecutive weak print would amplify recession concerns, potentially cap DXY and real yields, and provide relief for risk assets still recovering from the October 30 crash.
